Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-117636  
Guideline Name 
Eucrisa  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
1/1/2023  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Eucrisa  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - BOTH of the following:  
 
 1.1 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ONE topical corticosteroid [e.g., 
mometasone furoate, fluocinolone acetonide (generic Synalar), fluocinonide]  


--- PDF page 605 ---
Page 605 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 ONE of the following:  
 
  1.2.1 Patient is less than 2 years of age  
 
OR 
 
  1.2.2 Patient is greater than or equal to 2 years of age and has history of failure, 
contraindication, or intolerance to ONE topical calcineurin inhibitor [e.g., pimecrolimus 
(generic Elidel), tacrolimus (generic Protopic)]
